{{Quote|Orbital screens have been erected around Kuat's most guarded shipyards to dissuade long-range intelligence gathering. Similar sensor-baffling impediments have been erected around the space-based Neimoidian shipyards, while the distance from Republic frontlines have helped insulate Confederacy ship-producing facilities on Foerest and Sluis Van.|[[Shadowfeed/Legends|CIS Shadowfeed]]|<ref name="CSD-15:01:15" />}}
The '''Neimoidian shipyards''' were a [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyard]] located in [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the shipyards was affiliated with the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. It became a strategic point in the conflict due to its proximity with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]-aligned [[Kuat Drive Yards Orbital Array|Kuat shipyards]]. Both factions gathered forces in the less than six [[Parsec/Legends|parsecs]] area that separated Neimoidia and [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] and this small area of space became the site of rising tensions.<ref name="CSD-15:01:15" />
